༄༅/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so//

gnas mdo bka' brgyud kyi zab chos yang dag pa'o// na mo ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ye/ mdo rgyud gzhung lugs rgya che grangs mang yang*// tshe thung shes rab chung bas mtha' chod dka'// mang du shes kyang nyams su ma blang na// rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom grir shi dang 'dra// mkhas pa'i mal du tha mal ro 'byung srid// mdo rgyud lung dang rgya bod mkhas grub gsung*// byin rlabs che yang phal pas go ba dka'// grwa sar bshad pa byed na mkho lags kyang*// rtse gcig nyams su len la dgos pa chung*// de bas rgan mo 'dzub tshugs sems la phan// phyag rdzogs la sogs zab chos dpag med rnams// so so'i rang gzhung ma 'chug nges pa can// chos brgyud slob mar spel na mkho lags kyang*// rang don phyi ma'i don gnyer nyams len la// thams cad gcig tu dril nas nyams len zab// chos lugs ma 'chol kha gtsang tshugs bzang ba// grub mtha' bstan pa 'dzin la dgos mod kyi// phyi ma'i don gcig kho na bsam pa na// phyogs ris med par dag snang sbyang na zab// bla ma gcig la gcig chog blo gtad pa// de yi bu chen byed na dgos lags kyang*// rang la nyams rtogs yon tan skye 'dod na// 'brel thogs bla ma thams cad gcig tu bsdus// rigs kyi bdag por bsgoms nas gsol 'debs zab// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mang po yi// bskyed rim so so'i bsnyen sgrub so so ba// bla chen dbang bskur byed la mkho lags kyang*// sgrib pa sbyangs shing dngos grub thob pa'i thabs// thams cad kun 'dus lha gcig sngags gcig zab// rdzogs rim dmigs bcas dmigs med mang po rnams// khrid kha mang po 'chad la mkho lags kyang*// rang la nyams rtogs yon tan skye ba'i thabs// thams cad gcig bsdus ngo bo skyong na zab// spros pa phyi nas gcod dang nang nas gcod// lta ba'i ston lugs mi gcig mang na yang*// thab kyi me bsad du ba rang 'gags ltar// nang du rang sems rtsa ba gcod pa zab// mtshan bcas mtshan med sgom lugs mang na yang*// gsal stong zung 'jug bskyed rim dran rdzogs zab// spyod pa mtho dman rtsing zhib mang na yang*// dge sgrub sdig spang ci nus 'bad pa zab// 'bras bu thob dus thob lugs mang bshad kyang*// lta sgom spyod pa ma 'khrul nyams blang na// nges par thob pa'i nges shes ldan pa zab// bstan la phan phyir tshabs chen sdig ltung sogs// sa thob sems dpa' rnams la mi sgrib kyang*// rang re ngan song gsum la skrag pa'i phyir// sdig ltung the 'bags med par 'dzem pa zab// yar mchod mar sbyin 'bri dang klog pa sogs// rang don min par 'gro ba spyi yi don// 'khor gsum dmigs med bsngo ba rgyas 'debs zab// zab chos gdams pa'i glu ste dang po'o/// /

kye ma ho/ bskal pa mang ste dam chos dar ba dkon// zhing khams mang yang sangs rgyas 'byon pa dkon// sangs rgyas byon yang bstan pa gnas pa dkon// 'gro drug nang nas mi lus thob pa dkon// gling bzhi'i nang nas 'dzam gling skyes pa dkon// 'dzam gling nang nas dam chos dar ba dkon// de ru skyes kyang dbang po tshang ba dkon// dbang po tshang yang dam chos dran pa dkon// dam chos 'dod kyang bla ma mtshan ldan dkon// de dang mjal yang nyams khrid thob pa dkon// gal te thob kyang dbang gis smin pa dkon// de gnyis 'dzom yang rang ngo 'phrod pa dkon// dkon tshad thams cad da res rnyed pa 'di// stabs legs ma yin sngon gyi smon lam yin// da res 'khor ba 'di dang rgyab gyes shig /ma thub na ni rin chen gling nas ni// lag pa stong par 'ong las med par nges// phyi nas 'di 'dra 'dzom pa e srid tsam// khyad par gsang sngags bla med rdo rje theg /byams pa man chad sangs rgyas stong gis ni// gsung bar mi 'gyur thob pa'i re ba med// da res thob dka'i mi lus rin chen 'di// thob pa'i don la bed gcig ma chod na// ring por mi thog bskyur nas 'jog pa ste// bya khyis za 'am me yis bsreg rgyu yin// da res snying po med la snying po longs// zhus pa'i sdom pa dam tshig gtsang mar srungs// nya stong brgyad gsum bsnyen gnas sdom pa srung*// lag pa bed bcad brgya phyag rgyun du 'tshol// rkang pa bed bcad rten la bskor ba mdzod// lce la bed bcad chos spyod yig drug 'bungs// longs spyod bed bcad mchod sbyin tshogs gsog 'bad// sems la bed bcad stong nyid snying rje sgoms// da lta 'byung bzhis g.yar ba'i sgyu lus 'di// bed bcad byas nas gtad dgos byung yang bzod// rta khal lam brgyags bzang ba'i mgron po bzhin// 'gro dgos byung yang sdug bsngal yod pa min// thob dka'i mi lus la snying po len pa'i glu ste gnyis pa'o/// /

kye ma kyi hud a tsa ma na ang*// snod kyi 'jig rten nam zhig me chus 'jig /lo yang mi rtag lo skor rim par 'pho// nam zla dus bzhi dro grang sa mdog brje// nyi ma shar nub dus tshod yud yud 'gro// bcud kyi sems can skye rga na dang 'chi// mi rtag 'gyur ba chu yi gnyer ma 'dra// dngos por grub pa'i 'dus byas thams cad la// gcig kyang rtag par gnas pa mi srid de// skyes mtha' 'chi dang brtsigs pa'i mtha' ni 'gyel// dar mtha' rgud dang bsags pa'i mtha' ni 'dzad// 'dus mtha' 'bral ba 'di ni zlog thabs med// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob rnams kyang*// thams cad mthar ni sku lus spang dgos na// de la lhag pa su zhig gang du yod// tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang*// gling phyed dbang dang rgya bod hor sogs kyi// rgyal po chen po rnams kyang 'chi dgos na// bsod chung phal pa nam 'chi ci cha yod// nad rigs bzhi brgya bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad// tshe dang srog la gnod byed dpag tu med// rlung gseb mar me 'dra 'di nam 'da' ang*// dper na gsod sar 'khrid pa'i btson bzhin du// lo zla zhag dus song zhing 'chi dang nye// 'chi bdag gshin rje de dang nam thug ang*// sman dang srung ba rim gros nad pa rdugs// tug gi thug pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang*// nyi ma nub ri'i rtse la phyin pa ltar// bshol thabs med pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang*// nye du 'khor g.yog mang yang khrid dbang med// gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus shig nam 'ong ang*// longs spyod che yang zhag brgyags khyer dbang med// lag stong 'gro ba'i dus shig nam 'ong ang*// cha med yul du rgyus med gcig pur 'khyams// gar 'gro cha med dus shig nam 'ong ang*// na tsha zug gzer che yang bgo thabs med// sdug res gcig la babs dus nam 'ong ang*// thim rim snang mched 'od gsal ngos mi zin// ci bya gtol med dus shig nam 'ong ang*// sgra 'od zer gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'char// nyes chen mi gcig dmag gis bskor ba ltar// dngangs skrag 'jigs snang chen po nam 'ong ang*// 'jigs shing ya nga gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid// lhan skyes lha dang 'dre yis dge sdig bshad// rdzun gyis mi phan me long yig chung gsal// sngar byas 'gyod pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang*// dge ba 'dod kyang nyo skyi 'tshol khung med// gshin rje'i rgyal pos dkar nag shan 'byed byed// de dus 'gyod med da ltar ma bsgrub na// rang gis rang bslus 'do med snying med yin// da lta me stag phog pa mi bzod na// mi yi me las dmyal me bdun 'gyur tsha// 'chi rgyu med par bskal par btso dang bsreg

/byed par shes na ci bya sems la dris// dgun kha zhag gcig gos srab mi bzod na// bskal par gos med 'khyag pa'i sbubs su 'byar// 'chi rgyu med par byung na ci 'dra byed// da lta ngag bcad bsrung na klad yu 'khor// lo grang stong phrag zas skom sgra mi grags// 'on kyang 'chi mi nus na ci 'dra yod// da ltar khyi rgan zer nas gri mgo 'phur// dngos su khyi lus blang na ci 'dra byed// da lta dmag dang dgra la bros pas chog /lha min yul du skyes na ji ltar byed// da lta gral tsam dma' na zug rngu skye// lha lus ltung ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka'// ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal bzod glags med// lha mi'i bde ba mi rtag 'gyur ldog che// skye rga na 'chi chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya che gting zab la// mtha' med thar dus med pa'i 'jigs rung mang*// 'di la skrag phyir sdig la dug ltar 'dzem// 'di la phan pa'i dam chos sman ltar bsten// 'di la skyob pa'i dkon mchog dpon du khur// de ltar bshad pa'i don de ma go na// mngon sum blta rgyu gda' ba 'di rnams ltos// deng sang rgyal po chen po'i dmag bsdus kyang*// khri phrag bcu las mang bar 'dus dka' ste// mnga' zhabs na yang mi lus thob tshad la// 'bum phrag bcu las mang ba yod shas chung*// dbyar kha ri sogs re yi 'bu srin grangs// rgyal po chen po'i mnga' zhabs mi bas mang*// rgya grog re re'i tshang gi grog ma yang*// rgyal po chen po'i dmag dpung bas kyang mang*// mi lus thob de e dka' de la ltos// pha ma gcig cing rgod zhan mnyam pa'i spun// la la phyug cing la la dbul dang phongs// la la tshe thung nad mang sdug bsngal che// la la nad dkon tshe ring yun ring bde// mi lus rin chen thob pa 'dra 'dra la// la la btsan zhing la la nyam chung ba// la la phyug cing la la ltogs cing mug

/rgod zhan ma yin mkhas dang mi mkhas min// tshe sngon las 'bras e bden de la ltos// bskal pa chags nas da lta yan gyi mi// sus kyang 'chi ba 'tsher te thabs ma rnyed// gcig kyang tshe thar lus pa mi gda' na// rang gi ngo shes shi ba brtsi bsgrang thong*// na nyin du shi da lo du shi ba// rang yang de bas lhag don cung zad med// shi ba shes kyang de dus chos mkho ba// kun gyis shes kyang long yod bsam pas bslus// deng sang tshe tshad bzhi bcu kha ral gsungs// rang dang na mnyam rang bas gzhon pa'i mi// du shi yid la khrom la bsam blo thong*// de tshos kyang ni da rung mi 'chi bsam// dgra 'dul gnyen skyong 'dug chis sdig 'ga' byas// bsam thog ma song khong rnams 'chi bdag khyer// rang yang de dang 'dra bas dam chos mdzod// chos ma dran pas chos la 'dzud pa dang*// chos la zhugs pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i thabs// 'chi ba snying nas dran pa zab chos yin// gal te 'chi ba snying la ma gzer na// dam chos byang kyang che thabs rim gror gol// de phyir 'chi ba nyin re lan gsum du// snying la gzer bar dran pa zab chos so// mi rtag pa dang rgyu 'bras bsam pa'i glu ste gsum pa'o/// / e ma dngos gzhi dmigs pa'i skor 'di la// go rgyu re dang bsgom rgyu so sor yod// dang po go rgyu 'di tsho go ba long*// de nas bsgom rgyu'i dmigs thun ci nus sgoms// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan gyis mi skyob pas// bslu med dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad bca'// mdo lugs sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum// sngags lugs bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// don la bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su 'dus// ci mdzad khyed shes blo gtad skyabs 'gro yin// rang nyid sangs rgyas thob pas mi chog ste// sems can thams cad pha ma drin can yin// de dag thams cad sangs rgyas sar 'god pa'i// sems bskyed rgya chen sangs rgyas sa bon yin// rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis po bka' drin mnyam// pha rol phyin drug nyams su ma blangs par// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs med pas// sbyin pa gtang yul sems can dbul phongs can// snying rje bsgom yul sems can sdug bsngal can// phan log gnod skyel dgra bgegs thams cad ni// bzod pa sgom pa'i rten te byang chub grogs// de ltar shes pas phyogs dang ris med pa'i// 'gro kun bdag nyid kho nas sangs rgyas sar// bkod pa'i bsam bzang blo stobs bskyed pa ni// byang chub sems bskyed ces bya'i zab chos yin// ma bshags sdig pa chung yang ljid pa ste// zhag re song zhing skyed re 'gro bas 'phel// snying nas bshags na mi dag sdig pa med// mi gtsang 'gos kyang chu yis bkru dang mtshungs// sngar byas sdig pa btsan dug khong shor ltar// 'gyod par skyes na dag par sla ba yin// de thub bsam pa'i nga rgyal dag par dka'// phyin chad mi bya'i dam bca' drag po bya// byas kyang skyon med bshags chog bsam pa na// de yis dag par mi 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma spyi bor bsgom// de drung bshags pa rten gyi stobs zhes bya// bshags thabs mang yang yig drug zab pa'o// tshogs bsags gang yang ci nus 'bad bya ste// bya sla bsod nams che ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems grub thob tshogs// dpag tu med kyang mjal ba'i las dbang med// rang la dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang*// sangs rgyas kun las bla ma bka' drin che// bla ma tha mal pa zhig yin na yang*// rdo rje 'chang du mos pas gsol btab na// nyams rtogs yon tan skye zhing 'phel ba yin// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje yin par bshad// de phyir bla ma bsgom nas gsol ba btab// chos kyi sgor zhugs dbang lung khrid thob nas// sdom pa dam tshig bsrung bar ma byas na// sman dpyad dug tu song ltar phung bar byed// srung tshul zhib par mi shes bsrung dka' yang*// don rtsa gcig tu bsdus nas bsrungs pas 'thus// ci mdzad khyed shes dkon mchog blo khel ni// skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa thams cad de la 'thus// gzhan la gnod pa nam yang mi skyel na// 'dul khrims so thar sdom pa de la 'thus// dge ba thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bsngo// rang gi ci nus gzhan la phan gdags na// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa de la 'thus// rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam dbyer med lta// de la log lta nam yang ma byas na// gsang sngags dam tshig thams cad de la 'thus// de ltar sdom pa dam tshig ldan pa la// bla mas byin rlabs yi dam dngos grub ster// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bar chad sel bar nges// de ltar go nas bsgom rgyu'i dmigs thun ni// rang gi spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// 'brel thogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum// thams cad gcig bsdus 'od dpag med pa bsgom// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang shes bya// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge rtser bcas// gling bzhi ri rab rin chen sna tshogs ni// 'bul bar dmigs te maṇ+ḍal tshigs bcad brjod// sngar byas sdig la 'gyaud pas bshags tshig dang*// yig drug bzlas pas 'od dpag med pa yi// sku las bdud rtsi 'o ma 'dra ba babs// tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang ba yis// dud khu lta bu'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa// 'og sgo dang ni rkang pa'i mthil nas thon// sa 'og song bas 'chi bdag gshin rjes 'thung*// ngom zhing tshims pas tshe skyin srog blu gyur// rang lus dri med shel sgong lta bur gyur// de nas spyi bo'i bla ma sangs rgyas der// dad gus bskyed la gsol 'debs gang shes sam// gsol 'debs snying po badz+ra gu ru bzla// bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus 'od dpag med// 'od du zhu nas rang la dbyer med thim// sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid gsum po// dbyer med chu dang 'o ma 'dres ltar du// dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsgom// dmigs thun gyi glu ste bzhi pa'o/// /

don gyi rtsa ba bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam// 'di la go rgyu bsgom rgyu gnyis yod de// sems can kun gyi sems nyid ngo bo ni// ye nas sangs rgyas ngo bor bzhugs pa ste// ngo bo stong pa chos sku skye med nyid// rnam pa gsal la ma 'dres longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje 'gags med sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug ngo bo nyid// nam yang 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i sku// ye nas rang la rang chas bzhugs pa de// sangs rgyas thugs rje bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// chos kyi zab khyad gnad kyis byung ba'ang min// ye shes gdod nas de ltar yod pa yin// de don mdo sngags thams cad bshad pa mthun// 'o na 'khor ba ci phyir 'khyams zhe na// rang gis rang ngo ma shes 'khrul bas len// dper na gser gyi sgyed pu yod pa'i mis// gser ngo ma shes ltogs sdug mthong dang 'dra// de nyid bla mas ngo sprod bka' drin che// gser ngo sprad kyang ltogs la mi phan te// de nyid btsong dang zas bsgrub brngo btags dang*// btsos g.yos byas nas zos na bkres pa 'grang*// de bzhin bla mas ngo sprod byas pa de// nyams su blang na 'khrul pa sel te grol// de ltar rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa ni// theg chen mdo dang gsang sngags rgyud sde mthun// 'on kyang mdo nas rang lus sangs rgyas su// ngo sprod med pas lam thag ring ba ste// bskal pa grangs med gsum nas sangs rgyas thob// bla med tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// rang lus lha ru ngo sprad pa yis zab// de phyir rang lus lha yi dkyil 'khor du// bde mchog gsang 'dus bka' brgyad la sogs pa// bla med rgyud sde kun nas rgyas par gsungs// mdor bsdus phung po lnga ni rigs lnga ste// khams lnga yum lnga tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad// yul brgyad sems ma brgyad du gsar rnying mthun// khyad par snying dbus zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis// mgrin pa'i gnas su dag pa rig 'dzin tshogs// klad pa'i nang du khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad// rtsa rlung thig le'i tshul du dngos su bzhugs// de ltar snying dang mig gi rtsa 'brel nas// rdzogs chen nam mkha' 'ja' 'od thig le 'char// 'chi dus lus kyi lha tshogs lus nas thon// nam mkha' bar snang gang bar dngos su 'char// de nyid lha ru ma shes gshin rjer mthong*// sngangs skrag 'jigs snang brgyal 'bogs ngan song ltung*// dper na dgra 'jigs che ba'i lam so nas// bsu mi 'ong pa dgra yin snyam nas bros// rjes su bsnyegs pas ded par mthong nas skrag

/ngo shes na ni skrag med dga' ba ltar// yi dam lha ru shes na zhing khams bgrod// de nyid da lta goms 'dris bya ba'i phyir// thod rgal thig le thig phran blta ba'o// dper na dngul rdo dngul ni yin na yang*// bzhu btul ma byas dngul go mi chod ltar// rang lus yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor du// shes pas mi chog bsgoms pas dngos su grub// dper na 'o ma mar gyis khyab mod kyang*// ma bshig na ni mar du mi 'gyur ltar// rang sems sangs rgyas yin par go na yang*// ma bsgom pa la sangs rgyas mi 'gyur ro// de don shes par mdzod la nyams su longs// yi dam mang yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// yi dam kun 'dus bod kyi lha skal yin// bskyed lugs rgyas bsdus mang yang dran rdzogs 'di// nyams su len bde shes par sla ba yin// de phyir rang lus thugs rje chen po'i sku// dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi gzhung ltar bsgom// thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab drug gi /lte bar hrīḥdang 'dab drug yi ge drug /thams cad langs nas khra dang hrig ge bsgom// hrīḥyig mi 'gul yig drug g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mchod// thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas// char ltar babs nas rang la sib sib thim// slar yang yi ge drug las 'od zer 'phros// rigs drug sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs// thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas// kun gyi yi ge drug pa 'ur dir dir// snod kyi 'jig rten bde chen zhing du bsgyur// res 'ga' hrīḥl dmigs pa rtse gcig bzung*// gzhan du mi 'phro yun ring sems gnas na// dmigs bcas zhi gnas bskyed rim zung 'jug go /de nas de ltar sgom mkhan sems de la// hrig ge bltas pas bsgoms tshad stong par yal// sems la gzugs dang kha dog dngos po med// lus kyi phyi dang nang dang bar na'ang med// phyogs bcu kun tu btsal yang dngos po med// gang nas skyes dang gar gnas gar 'gro med// med pa'ang ma yin rang sems gsal hrig ge

/gcig pu ma yin sna tshogs ci yang 'char// tha dad ma yin thams cad ngo bo gcig /kho yi ngo bo sus kyang brjod med shes// phyogs mthun brjod na brjod rgyu zad mtha' med// ming ni sems nyid bdag dang kun gzhi sogs// tha snyad rnam grangs mang po btags mod kyang*// don la da lta'i shes pa 'di ka rang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba 'di rang yin// sangs rgyas thob dang ngan song ltung ba dang*// bar dor 'khyams dang skye ba bzang ngan dang*// zhe sdang khong khro chags sems zhen chags dang*// dad pa dag snang byams dang snying rje dang*// nyams rtogs yon tan sa lam thob pa sogs// thams cad byed mkhan sems nyid de ga rang*// kun gyi 'ching rtsa phung rtsa 'di yin pas// srog rtsa bcad na dbang po kun 'gags ltar// 'di don rtogs shing nyams su sus blangs pa// chos rnams thams cad de ru ma 'dus med// 'di la sgom rgyu spu tsam med pa ste// ma yengs kho rang ngo bo bltas pas chog /legs su re dang nyes kyi dogs pa dang*// yin nam min nam gang yang mi sems par// gnas sam 'gyu 'am gsal lam mi gsal rung*// gang shar de yi ngo bo hrig ger blta// dngos gzhi de ltar sgom pa'i dus de ru// mi 'phro kyi ler gnas na gnas pa ste// mi sdod phyogs bcur rgyug pas 'gyu ba yin// gnas 'gyu gang shar rig pas rig pa ste// so sor 'char yang ngo bo gcig nyid yin// gnas pa chos sku 'gyu ba sprul pa'i sku// rig pa longs sku dbyer med ngo bo nyid// sku gsum 'grub pa'i rgyu 'am sa bon yin// de ltar gnas 'gyu gnyis la bzang ngan med// de phyir gdam ka ma byed gang shar skyong*// dang po yun thung grangs mang yang yang blta// de na rim par yun ni je ring blta// las dang po pas bskyed rdzogs la btsan thabs su bslab pa'i glu ste lnga pa'o/// / e ma ho/ deng sang khrid chung ston mkhan mang ba'i mthus// phyogs mgo de tsam shes pa mang lags kyang*// tshe 'di'i snang ba bslu mkhas nyams dga' zhing*// mi rtag 'chi ba snying la ma gzer bas// shes tsam de la lus pa shin tu mang*// khrid mang zhus kyang go dred slar la 'khreb// sdig la mi 'dzem spyod pa phal las lod// khrid zhus pa la gzhan gyis mtshang 'bru byed// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa med pas len// lam sne shes kyang 'gro bar ma byas na// jo bo la sogs mjal thabs med dang 'dra// de la dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum// rab la 'jig rten bya ba spang mi dgos// 'jig rten bya ba nyams len bsre zhing bsgom// 'dod yon ma spangs lam du khyer ba ste// rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi lta bu yin// 'bring la 'jig rten bya ba phal cher spangs// rab byung ngang tshul bzung la nyams su len// bza' btung zas gos 'byor bar bya ba ste// rgya bod paṇa grub bla ma phal cher yin// tha mas blo rtse gnyis kyis don mi 'grub// chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gnyis mi lcogs// tshe 'di blos btang lto gos rgyab bskyur bsgoms// mi la rgod tshang la sogs rnam thar yin// de gsum gang ltar byed kyang gnyug bsring nas// mi bskyur nyams su blang bas nyams rtogs 'char// de yang gang zag khams dang dbang po yis// gcig la 'char ba kun la mi 'char te// la la dang nas nyams rtogs mthon po 'char// la la res 'char res ni thabs rdugs 'byung*// la la rim par je drag je drag 'char// 'on kyang shar lugs rim gyis bshad par bya// dang po sems ni skad cig sdod mi nyan// gar yang rgyug cing mi dran dgu yang dran// de tshe lus gnad bsrang la lhod de klod// gar 'gro bltas la rgyang so btsugs pas ni// tshur la 'khor nas cung zad gnas pa 'ong*// gnas dang 'gyu ba gnyis ka zhi gnas ste// ngo bo stong par rtogs na lhag mthong yin// gnas sam 'gyu 'am stong pa de nyid ni// dbyer med gcig tu rtogs na zung 'jug go

/de ltar rtogs nas nyams su len pa'i tshe// res 'ga' mi re kyi le gnas pa'i tshe// 'di nyid rang sems red snyam dga' ba skye// res 'ga' mi gnas rlung ltar 'tshubs shing rgod// bltas kyang blta rgyu mi rnyed ban bun 'tshubs// ma red 'di yin med snyam zhe mi dga'// de dus rnam rtog gang shar gcig ngos bzung*// de nyid gang nas byung dang gar 'gro dang*// gar gnas bltas pas mi rnyed stong pa nyid// dper na smyug gcig bcad nas bltas pa na// smyug ma thams cad nang gi stong par shes// de bzhin rnam rtog gcig ni stong par rtogs// rnam rtog thams cad de dang 'dra ba'i phyir// gnas nas dga' dang 'gyu na mi dga' med// chu dang chu rlabs gnyis la khyad med ltar// gnas 'gyu khyad med gang shar ngo bo blta// de yang rgod cing 'tshub na lus sems klod// bying zhing mi gsal rmugs na sgrim la blta// de nas skabs shig 'gyu ba nyung du 'gro// me re kyi ler gnas shing res 'ga' 'phro// 'phros kyang myur du gnas pa'i steng du sleb// de la gnas pa chags zhes ming du btags// de nas nyams len de nyid skyong ba'i tshe// sal le sing nge hrig ge ye re ba// dper na mtsho la rlabs kyis mi gnod ltar// 'gyu ba cung zad shar yang mi gnod pa// de 'dra res 'byung res ni mi 'byung la// res 'ga' sgom bsam lus gnad bcas kyang dka'// res 'ga' ma bsgom na yang de ltar 'char// de nas lus bde sems bde kyi ler gnas// 'gro 'dug spyod lam phal gyis de mi gnod// sgom par 'dod pa'i brod pa de nas rnyed// res 'ga' rmi lam du yang zin par 'byung*// nga yi nyams rtogs bzang po yin snyam nas// de la chags zhen 'dzin pa dam por skye// de la chags zhen mi bya ngo bor blta// rnam pa bde dang ngo bo stong pa gnyis// dbyer med bde stong phyag rgya chen po 'char// chags shing zhen na 'dod lhar skye ba'i rgyu// la la rnam rtog dgra ru bltas nas ni// ci yang mi dran pa de sgom yin snyam// de ni rgya nag ha shang lta ba zer// ci yang mi dran thom me lus pa ni// 'gog pa cha mthun dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu// dran rgyu yod kyang dran ni mi bcug par// rnam shes snying khar bsdus nas gnas pa ni// 'gog pa zhes bya nyan thos lam yin no// de phyir 'gyu ba ched du mi dgag cing*// ched du mi spro gang shar ngo bo blta// bltas pas dngos po ci yang mi mthong ba// de tshe stong nyid don dam mthong ba yin// ma mthong ngang la mthong rgyu med par ltar// res 'ga' bltas kyang mi gsal bun ne ba// 'gyu ba ban bun 'tshub cing snying mi 'ga'// sgom lugs 'di la rkyang 'ded mos par 'dra// bsam pa'i the tshom rtog pa 'ga' re long*// de nyid rtsub nyams yin pas ngan rgyu med// lus sems klod la lta stangs nam mkhar gtad// nam mkha' sngo sang rang sems bsres la blta// sems kyi dwangs snyigs phyed de gsal stong 'char// res 'ga' gsal rig stong gsum rjen lhang nge// rtogs pa mthon po yin snyam nga rgyal skye// sus kyang blo mi 'gyur ba'i nges shes skye// de dus nges shes nga rgyal dbang song na// gzugs khams lha yi gnas su skye ba'i rgyu// gsal ba'i ngo bor bltas pas stong pa nyid// gsal stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po 'char// res 'ga' lus sems thams cad stong pa nyid// thams cad stong par mthong nas chos gtam mtho// nam mkha' stong pas cis kyang mi gos ltar// dge sdig phan gnod yod don mi 'dug snyam// spyod pa rtsing zhing dge ba mi sgrub na// stong lta had po ngan song 'gro ba'i rgyu// stong pa nyid la lta nyes de la zer// de ltar thams cad stong par mthong na yang*// ngo bo skyong zhing rgyu 'bras blang dor 'bad// de ltar nyams kyi rim pa de dag kyang*// yun ring gnas dang thung ngur yal ba sogs// gcig tu mi sdod nam mkha' 'gyur ldog 'dra// de nas rnam rtog nyung du ma song yang*// rnam rtog mang yang sgom la mi gnod pa// mtsho la char pa babs bzhin sgom du 'char// de nas bskyed rdzogs res 'jog mi dgos te// nyams len stong pa'i rtsi dang ma bral bar// rang lus yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon shar ltar bsgom// yi ge drug pa gong bas thos tsam bzla// gsum ka mi bshol nyams len bde ba yin// sgom pa'i dus kyang dka' tshegs med pa ru// dran pa tsam nas nyams len steng du slebs// de la nyams len skyong bde zhes bya 'o// de nas sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa// bltas pas thams cad na bun ji bzhin du// so sor gsal yang ngo bo stong pa mthong*// sems dang nam mkha' dbyer med gcig 'dres nas// nam mkhas gar khyab sems kyis khyab snyam byed// thams cad sems yin sems la ngo bo med// ci yang med pa'i stong nyid yin snyam byed// yod pa ma yin dngos po rdul tsam med// med pa ma yin sna tshogs cir yang 'char// yod min med min gcig ni yin snyam byed// de dag 'dzin pa dam pos bcings na ni// gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba ste// gang la'ang 'dzin pa'i nges shes mi bya bar// 'dzin med gang shar ngo bor lhug ger blta// de nas blta rgyu blta mkhan gcig tu 'dres// 'di blta de lta 'di sgom de sgom med// 'di yin de yin med pa'i tha mal 'dra// res 'ga' tha mal nyid du bzhag pa las// gang yang bya rgyu zad pa'i dus zhig 'byung*// sngar gyis bde gsal mi rtog de yang med// thos pa chung bas nga yi sgom por snyam// sngar ltar e 'ong tshad kyang mi 'byung sdug

/ham pa che na sgom med yin nam snyam// de dag ngo bo mthong ba zhes bya ste// tha mal shes pa rjen par rtogs pa yin// chos kun rang gi sems su thag chod cing*// sems ni stong nyid smra bsam brjod dang bral// ma bcos rang gar bzhag pa ma gtogs pa// bya rgyu med kyang skabs su yengs pa'i dus// rang ngo mi mthong tha mal 'khrul par 'chor// yengs 'dug snyam du 'gyod sems dran pas zin// dran pas ma zin bar du tha mal pa// dran pas zin tsam nyams len nyid du 'char// 'di dus dran pas yang yang gsal 'debs bya// lta stangs yang yang byas pas gsal cha che// res 'ga' rtse gcig dben sar sgom pa dang*// res 'ga' spyod lam kun tu bsre zhing bsgom// 'di nas mdo rgyud grub thob gsung rnams kun// dpe cha bltas pas sems dang 'phrod pa 'ong*// brtson 'grus che na rmi lam yang yang zin// brtson 'grus chung na zin grangs nyung du 'gro// phyis nas phyi rol snod bcud thams cad kun// rnam pa so sor ma 'dres gsal na yang*// ngo bo chab rom chu ru zhu ba ltar// thams cad stong nyid sems dang dbyer med 'dres// sgom pa'ang sems yin ma bsgoms pa yang sems// sems ni ye nas ma grub stong pa nyid// bsgom dang ma bsgom yengs dang ma yengs sogs// khyad med ye nas stong nyid gnas gshis rtogs// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang 'gro drug sems// ye nas ngo bo dbyer med stong pa nyid// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med don de ni// dpe rgyud bltas dang bla mas gsungs pa yi// go ba skam po min par rang rgyud la// nang nas tshur la 'char bar 'gyur ba yin// de tsam byung na rtogs ldan ming thogs tsam// de tsam mthon po yin par mi sems te// rang nyams shar tshod phan pa'i sems kyis bshad// gsang sgrogs gyur na lha dang bla mar bshags// de yan phyin ma myong ba'i rna thos kyis// sa rgyus 'dod na dpe rgyud rnams la ltos// de ltar zag bcas zag med dge ba rnams// dper na rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba ltar// 'khor gsum yang dag bsngo bas bsngo bar gces// 'khor gsum yongs dag bshad lugs mang na yang*// nyams len de yi ngang nas bsngo bas 'thus// skye ba sla zhing phan yon rgya che bas// bde ba can du skye ba'i bsngo smon mdzod// skye 'am mi skye snyam pa'i the tshom spangs// skye bar nges pa sangs rgyas smon lam yin// nam zhig bar dor khyams par ngo shes tshe// zhing khams de ru 'gro bar thag chod pa// da lta'i dus nas yid la dung nge mdzod// bar dor dran ma thag nas sleb pa yin// nyams 'char lugs gegs sel gyi glu ste drug pa'o/// /

bla ma rang sems ngo bo dbyer med cing*// stong nyid chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig kyang*// rig rtsal ma 'gags bla ma 'od dpag med// spyi bor bsgoms la gsol ba btab pas na// byin rlabs shugs kyis rtogs par bogs skyed 'ong*// de phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyun du bsgom// yi dam rang sems snang cha yin rtogs kyang*// rang lus yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku// snang stong dbyer med bsgoms la yig drug bzla// gzugs sku'i sa bon theb pa'i rten 'brel dang*// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gsang sngags bstan pa yin// 'gro drug sems can rang bzhin ma grub kyang*// ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can la// shugs 'byung byams dang snying rje chen po yis// 'gro drug sems can sdig dang sdug bsngal kun// rlung gis rngubs la thams cad rang la bstim// sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bsgom// rang gi bsod nams dge rtsa ci yod pa// dbugs phyir btang dang mnyam du 'gro la bstim// 'gro kun bde skyid tshad med thob par bsgom// sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs la med dka' med// gtong len dmigs pa zab chos snying po yin// snga dro dgong mo sūr+ya'i 'od zer la// zim bur tsak+ṣus bltas pas 'ja' 'od zer// thig le thig phran yig 'bru lha sku 'char// de dang nyams len sems ngo bsres la blta// gsal stong zung 'jug longs sku'i zhing khams mthong*// lta ba yid dpyod tsam du ma lus pa'i// mngon sum blta chog rdzogs chen zab gnad yin// bogs 'don gyi glu ste bdun pa'o/// / ('di nyams len byed skabs mtshan nyid ldan pa las dbang lung khrid gsum zhus nas gsang zhing nyams su len dgos/ dad med log lta can la bshad na srung mas bka' chad 'bebs par gsung bas gsang dgos/ mchan/) e ma ho/ bla ma bsten cing dam chos byas pa'i don// 'chi dus 'di byed khrig ge yod pa dgos// de min dgra byung blo stor ci cha yod// nam 'chi cha med rgyun du yid la bzhag

/chags pa che chung med par chags na 'ching*// lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus bskyur dgos na// gnyen dang nor la chags pa bsam med rang*// gnyen dang nye du nor rdzas rang lus bcas// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la yid kyis phul// 'bul ba tshar nas bdag po med pa ltar// sus khyer sus bdag yid la 'phreng dog med// rang lus yi dam thugs rje chen por bsgom// spyi bor bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus pa// 'od dpag med mgon bsgoms la gsol ba btab// bu ga brgyad po hrīḥyig re res bkag /lus dbus dbu ma mda' snyug 'bring po tsam// snying dbus rang sems hrīḥyig dkar po gcig /yar spar 'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar bstim// de 'dra'i dmigs pa brgya 'am nyer gcig tsam// de nas yid la ci yang mi bsam par// nyams len sems ngo'i steng du sa ler bzhag /snang mched thob gsum thim rim ci shar yang*// so sor 'di yin ngos bzung bya mi dgos// rang sems min par ci yang 'char rgyu med// gang shar de yi ngo bo nyid la blta// phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad tsam// gzhi yi 'od gsal sprin med nam mkha' ltar// tshur la 'char dus de yi ngang la bzhag /yun ring gnas na thugs dam zin pa yin// rtags ni mdog legs mig ni zim bur lta// kha yang 'dzum pa 'dra na zin par bshad// tsog pu skyil krung seng ge'i nyal stabs sogs// gdung g.yog pa la gang byung ma gtogs pa// don la nyal dang langs la khyad par med// gal te ma zin pa 'am 'drog na yang*// 'chi khar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa byas pa des// rnam shes tshangs bug thon pas phan yon che// chos sku'i 'pho ba thugs dam don gcig pas// gnyis mi 'gal 'di gnad che brling ba yin// de nas bar dor 'khyams par gyur na yang*// gang shar de yi ngo bor bltas pa yis// rang sems 'khrul pa'i stong gzugs nyid las gzhan// zhi ba khro bo gshin rje gcig kyang med// de nas skye ba len pa'i grab byung na// 'khor ba thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// rigs drug skye ba rdzi bo'i res ltar 'khor// skye rga na 'chi 'phreng rdog bzhin du bsgrangs// des na 'khor bar sun drags zhe bcad drag

/ngan song sdug bsngal de ni bsam mi tshugs// lha dang mi yang skye 'chi'i 'khor lor 'khor// da ni sdug bsngal kun bral bde ba'i gnas// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// 'od dpag med la dam chos nyan du 'gro// bsam par byas te chags zhen spangs la 'gro// da lta bzhin du gom pas 'gro mi dgos// bya bzhin gshog pas 'phur yang mi dgos te// yid kyi lus des dran ma thag nas sleb// der skyes gtan du bde zhing sdug bsngal med// 'gro ba sems can don yang 'byung ba ste// sa thob nas ni sprul pas gzhan don byed// 'chi tshe 'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar bstim// 'chi ba lam khyer gyi glu ste brgyad pa'o/// / de ltar nyams len glu chung le 'u brgyad// dad ldan tshong dpon bu lu zhes bya bas// shog gu phul ba'i bldabs len la dmigs nas// zhag gsum khrid chung bshad pa'i brjed tho la// stag lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes gnyis nyin// rdzogs par bris 'di rā ga as+yas so// 'phral du yid la gang shar bris pa la// 'gal ba mchis na mkhas pa rnams la bshags// dge bas bde ba can du skye phyir bsngo// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid rdzogs rim rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅgalaṃ/// /
